name: Volunteer Program at Surrey Memorial Hospital
what_you_do: Help with information, giving directions and office tasks. You also support patients. Some units need volunteers who are 20 or older.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older depending on the program. Parent or guardian consent is needed under 18. ICU, NICU and Palliative Care need age 20+.
duration: One shift a week on the same day for at least 6 months
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Applications are kept on file for four months.
how_to_apply: Apply online. If you qualify, you get an interview. Then you need a police record check and two references. You also do online orientation and training.
notes: Page last updated Aug 2, 2024. The STIR research program on the same page is for undergraduates, not high school.
